title: Mesh attribute
description: A vertex attribute of a mesh file. Listed in the order they come in the file; position and normal always come first. color0 is the vertex colour (4 floats, as stored); uv0_zw and uv1_zw are the third and fourth floats of a four-float UV set, uv2 and uv3 always four floats (SpeedTree keeps its wind data in them).
